meta.name: avoid-ai-writing
meta.description: Audit and rewrite prose so it stops reading as machine-generated. Use this skill when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit a draft for AI tells, audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, a rewrite mode, and an edit-in-place mode, with optional voice and context profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文稿读起来像真人写作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要让机器写的文案更像真人手笔
copy.tagline_en: Make any text read less like AI and more like you.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to remove AI-sounding phrasing from drafts and posts.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会先定位文字里像 AI 写作的痕迹（用词、句式、节奏等），然后根据你选的模式输出：问题清单、改写版，或在文件中做最小修改。它不会给原文强加语气、观点或虚构细节。
howto.when: 当用户要求去除文字中的AI腔、检查AI写作痕迹，或审计 README、博客、发布说明等文本时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这段话有没有AI痕迹，只报告别改。
say.note: 触发检测模式，只标记问题。

say.text: 把这段博客文章改得不像AI写的。
say.note: 默认重写模式，输出改写版和改动总结。

say.text: 用编辑模式改一下 notes.txt 里的文字。
say.note: 需要指定文件，做最小就地修改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans your text for AI-sounding patterns such as word choice, sentence rhythm, and structure, then acts per the selected mode: list issues, produce a rewrite, or edit a file in place. It never adds tone, opinions, or invented specifics to the original.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to strip AI-isms, check for AI writing patterns, or audit prose like a README, blog post, changelog, or release note.

say_en.text: Check this text for AI tells; report only, don't rewrite.
say_en.note: Switches to detect mode; flags only.

say_en.text: Rewrite this blog post so it sounds less like AI.
say_en.note: Runs default rewrite mode and summarizes changes.

say_en.text: Edit notes.txt in place to clean up AI patterns.
say_en.note: Touches the file minimally; confirms the result.
